fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Greater Miami civic and economic conditions, including predictions of a real-estate upswing and calls to clear property titles; concerns about housing vacancies, rents, and where workers will live; advocacy for drilling for natural gas/oil to support industry; complaints about sanitation and cleanup along the Miami River; discussion of transient seasonal merchants and winter tourism; and coverage of local sports and entertainment (boxing events, golf in Miami Beach, and venue notices). Also contains letters to the editor and extensive local advertising.
